items.title: 准备 session_brief baseline 与 12 个候选样本
items.context: 候选要覆盖 next step 前置、压缩 activity、突出 dirty git、合并 reviewer/artifact、极简/详细/中文行动式等结构化变体。

happy.desc: 生成 baseline 和 12 个 session_brief 候选样本 → 文件数量与命名完整

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:4 — samples-complete verifies baseline plus 12 session_brief candidate files exist with expected naming | severity:info

edge.desc: 候选样本缺少必需块 → 脚本仍能评分并在 contentSummary 标出缺失项

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:18 — samples-missing-signals verifies deficient candidate still scores and contentSummary shows missing reviewerStatus | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 候选目录为空 → 实验脚本明确失败并提示缺少 candidates

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:33 — samples-empty-fails verifies candidate generation prerequisites are enforced | severity:info

items.title: 跑 session-brief-quality-v1 实验并生成跑前跑后对比
items.context: 输出每个候选相对 baseline 的 score、normalizedScore、contentSummary、长度变化、patch/diff 摘要。

happy.desc: 运行实验脚本 → 输出 baseline 与 12 个候选的 score/normalizedScore/length delta/contentSummary

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:48 — scores-table verifies all 12 candidates have score/normalizedScore data | severity:info

edge.desc: 候选分数低于 baseline → 报告仍保留并标记 negative delta

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:63 — negative-delta-kept verifies below-baseline candidates remain in the report with negative deltas | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 评分脚本遇到不可解析候选 → 报告该候选失败但不中断其它候选汇总

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:78 — bad-candidate-contained verifies poor candidates are scored low without aborting the experiment | severity:info

items.title: 产出推荐报告与下一步代码修改建议
items.context: 报告不直接改生产代码，而是选出 1-3 个候选并说明为什么值得后续实现。

happy.desc: 生成推荐报告 → 包含 Top 3、baseline 对比、推荐实现和不推荐项

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:93 — report-top3 verifies the markdown report includes Top 3 and Recommendation sections | severity:info

edge.desc: 最高分候选太长 → 报告能说明分数与人工可读性 tradeoff

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:108 — report-tradeoff verifies the report explains compression/readability tradeoff | severity:info

adversarial.desc: 候选缺少 Git dirty 或 next step 关键风险提示 → 报告不推荐该候选

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/session-brief-experiment.json:123 — report-no-production-change verifies the report does not recommend unsafe production changes when baseline wins | severity:info
